rule: Element-level lane divergences that exist on main today, registered BY SCENARIO, ELEMENT PATH and PROPERTY with the ticket that owns the fix. Exact both ways: a delta not listed here fails the gallery gate, and a listed row that no longer differs fails until it is deleted. Tolerances are never widened to admit a row. A row may carry a host (windows-11-x64, macos-x64-intel, macos-arm64) when the divergence was measured on that host only: on other hosts the row is IGNORED, neither asserted nor stale, so each host is held to its own census. A row without a host applies on every host. Never scope a row to a host without measuring it there with the measure flag.
